local_failure_all_r_ge_3: By the sharp nonproportionality theorem, for every r>=3 there exists e_k with w_(r,k)!=lambda_r.

uniform_asymptotic_failure.claim: No scalar sequence lambda_r can satisfy sup_k |w_(r,k)-lambda_r| -> 0.
uniform_asymptotic_failure.proof: If such lambda_r existed, both canonical axis and central turns would approach lambda_r, so their weight difference would approach zero. But w_mid(r)-w_axis(r)->1-sqrt(3)/2>0.
